notes.title: Update on August 27, 2025: Added Stage 2 and a new weapon.
notes.content: [olist][*][p]Added Stage 2, approximately three times the length of Stage 1.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the difficulty of Stage 1 so beginners can clear it more easily.[/p][/*][*][p]Added jumping in place as well as forward, backward, left, and right jumps.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased dodge distance slightly.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new weapon, the Scythe, along with its skills.[/p][/*][*][p]Added grab skills for melee weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Added items that expand maximum HP and MP.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed skill learning to be available at save points, and items can now be purchased.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new basic enemy type.[/p][/*][*][p]Various other optimizations and improvements.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Stage 3 is planned for release around February 2026, and will also include new pistol skills and another ranged weapon.[/p][p]If you enjoy my game, please consider leaving a review on Steam.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="altNPK0JC9I;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: February 22, 2025 Update
notes.content:
1. Lowered the difficulty and optimized the difficulty curve.
2. Double jump and aerial dodge no longer restrict each other.
3. Increased the attack hitbox range of the spinning slash.

If you enjoy my game, please consider leaving a review on Steam.

notes.title: Updated January 16, 2025
notes.content:
1. Add 2K and 4K resolutions.
2. Optimize the camera
3. Optimize the tutorial
4. Add Portuguese (Brazil).

About the update plan for 2025:
1: The goal is to update at least two MISSIONS, each corresponding to a new weapon.
2: Add new skills to existing weapons.
3: Continue to optimize the user experience

Welcome to send bugs, feedback or suggestions in the discussion area.
